body:
## Pull request overview

This PR fixes test failures in multiple packages caused by unresolved imports in the shared `vitest.setup.tsx` file. The setup file imports several workspace packages as side effects to register components, but packages using it lacked the necessary Vite path aliases to resolve these imports during test execution.

**Changes:**
- Added consistent path aliases to `vite.config.ts` in 10 packages that reference `vitest.setup.tsx`
- Standardized alias paths to point to `/src` directories instead of `/src/index.ts` files
- Added self-reference aliases for `components` and `fields` packages to resolve circular imports

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 10 out of 10 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.

<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |

| packages/fields/vite.config.ts | Added 7 workspace package aliases including self-reference for vitest.setup.tsx compatibility |
| packages/plugin-aggrid/vite.config.ts | Added 7 workspace package aliases for vitest.setup.tsx import resolution |
| packages/plugin-charts/vite.config.ts | Added 7 workspace package aliases for vitest.setup.tsx import resolution |
| packages/plugin-editor/vite.config.ts | Added 7 workspace package aliases for vitest.setup.tsx import resolution |
| packages/plugin-form/vite.config.ts | Updated existing 3 aliases to directory format and added 4 new aliases for vitest.setup.tsx |
| packages/plugin-grid/vite.config.ts | Updated existing 3 aliases to directory format and added 4 new aliases for vitest.setup.tsx |
| packages/plugin-kanban/vite.config.ts | Added 7 workspace package aliases for vitest.setup.tsx import resolution |
| packages/plugin-markdown/vite.config.ts | Added 7 workspace package aliases for vitest.setup.tsx import resolution |
| packages/plugin-timeline/vite.config.ts | Added 7 workspace package aliases for vitest.setup.tsx import resolution |
</details>

The PR title "[WIP] Update logs for action run details" does not match the actual changes made in this pull request. The changes are about fixing vitest setup file import resolution by adding path aliases to vite.config.ts files across multiple packages. The title should be updated to accurately reflect these changes, such as "Fix vitest setup file import resolution in multiple packages" which is already used in the PR description.

The plugin-grid package is missing a self-reference alias. The vitest.setup.tsx file imports '@object-ui/plugin-grid' as a side-effect (line 16 of vitest.setup.tsx). When running tests in the plugin-grid package itself, this import needs to resolve to the local source code, similar to how '@object-ui/components' and '@object-ui/fields' packages handle self-references on lines 28 and 20 of their respective vite.config.ts files. Add: '@object-ui/plugin-grid': resolve(__dirname, './src'), // Self-reference for vitest.setup.tsx
```suggestion
      '@object-ui/plugin-grid': resolve(__dirname, './src'), // Self-reference for vitest.setup.tsx
```
